text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear position statement and repeated thesis","quality":"stance clarity","description":"It states a definite position right away and keeps that position consistent throughout the essay."},{"evidence":"three developed body paragraphs on safety, attention, and laws","quality":"development","description":"It gives multiple reasons and expands each one instead of briefly listing concerns."},{"evidence":"“As stated in the article...” and “In the article it is mentioned...”","quality":"textual support","description":"It directly refers to the source article several times to back up its claims."},{"evidence":"explains accidents, malfunctions, and legal responsibility","quality":"reasoning","description":"It connects evidence to consequences and shows why the concerns matter."},{"evidence":"intro, body, conclusion with transitions like “Which brings me to my next point”","quality":"organization","description":"It is arranged into a more coherent argumentative structure that guides the reader through the case."},{"evidence":"“There should not be different sets of laws... less confusion and complications”","quality":"counterargument handling","description":"It anticipates a possible legal counterpoint and responds by explaining why that issue is still a problem."}]}
